description: Maximum clique cardinality by ordered candidate-intersection DFS with a suffix-optimum upper bound.

source.title: Maximum Clique Search Algorithm
source.reference: OI Wiki graph/max-clique chapter, first MaxClique solver
source.algorithm_attribution: The bounded profile follows the chapter's increasing-candidate DFS, candidate-neighborhood intersections, remaining-candidate bound, and suffix-optimum dp bound. The port is clean-room and uses no source code or prose.
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; algorithm description only

input.adjacency_mask_range: nonnegative masks with bits only in [0,n)
input.graph: simple undirected and loopless; each row mask is symmetric with its opposite row

workspace.meaning: Fixed adjacency and suffix-bound arrays plus recursion state of depth at most 24.

contract.root_order: Process possible minimum clique vertices in descending ID order.
contract.candidate_order: At each recursive level, visit candidate vertices in increasing ID order and recurse on the remaining candidates intersected with the chosen vertex's neighborhood.
contract.pruning: Prune when chosen size plus the remaining candidate count cannot beat the incumbent, or when chosen size plus the previously computed optimum for the candidate's ID suffix cannot beat it.
contract.early_return: After a search first improves the incumbent for root i, end that root's DFS. Every clique containing i has size at most one plus the best clique wholly in vertices greater than i.
contract.validation: Reject negative/out-of-domain masks, self loops, asymmetric adjacency, truncated frames, and trailing words.

oracle_method: The primary reference uses ordered DFS and suffix pruning. The independent reference enumerates all vertex subsets and checks pairwise adjacency; it is used on fixtures with at most 16 vertices. The 24-vertex cases have hand-derived answers and are checked against the primary reference only.
